Forms: what you can do now, and how

_forms:
  scm:close: {…}
  scm:merge:
    title: Merge
    description: Merge the pull request into its base branch.
    _links:
      target:
        href: /repos/JogoShugh/heart-github-test/
              pulls/2325/actions/merge
    method: PUT
    contentType: application/json
    schema:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [method]
      properties:
        method:
          title: Merge method
          enum: [merge, squash, rebase]
        commit_title:
          type: string
        commit_message:
          type: string
  scm:comment:
    title: Comment
    _links:
      target:
        href: /repos/JogoShugh/heart-github-test/
              pulls/2325/actions/comment
    method: POST
    contentType: application/json
    schema:
      type: object
      required: [body]
      properties:
        body:
          type: string
          description: The contents of the comment.
  scm:label: {…}
  scm:edit: {…}
  scm:request-review: {…}
  scm:update-branch: {…}
# 7 forms, while open
say: The open pull request offers seven forms. scm:merge in full: its target, method, content type and JSON Schema, from GitHub's own description, with the merge method as scm's input. scm:comment needs one field, body. These are real, from the L0 run on GitHub.
